_comment: SIH26038 Phase 9 — reporting config. All user-facing wording lives here, not in Python. Screening-support language only; never diagnostic.

reason_translations.IMAGE_UNGRADABLE: Image quality is insufficient for reliable automated screening.
reason_translations.HIGH_DR_SEVERITY: Predicted DR severity meets the urgent-review screening criterion.
reason_translations.REFERABLE_DR_PREDICTION: Predicted DR severity meets the referable screening criterion.
reason_translations.HEMORRHAGE_EVIDENCE: Hemorrhage candidate regions were detected by the lesion-evidence module.
reason_translations.HARD_EXUDATE_EVIDENCE: Hard-exudate candidate regions were detected by the lesion-evidence module.
reason_translations.MICROANEURYSM_EVIDENCE: Microaneurysm candidate regions were detected by the lesion-evidence module.
reason_translations.SOFT_EXUDATE_EVIDENCE: Soft-exudate candidate regions were detected by the lesion-evidence module.
reason_translations.MULTIPLE_LESION_TYPES: Candidate regions of more than one lesion type were detected.
reason_translations.LOW_MODEL_CONFIDENCE: Calibrated model confidence is below the review threshold.
reason_translations.EVIDENCE_MODEL_CONFLICT: Explicit evidence and model prediction show limited spatial agreement; human review is recommended.
reason_translations.CONFLICT_ESCALATED_TO_REFER: Evidence conflict matches a configured escalation pattern.
reason_translations.ENHANCEMENT_FAILED: Borderline image quality could not be enhanced; grading was withheld.
reason_translations.PROCESSING_FAILURE: A processing component reported a failure.
reason_translations.NON_REFERABLE_PREDICTION: Predicted DR severity is below the referable screening criterion.
reason_translations.BORDERLINE_IMAGE_ENHANCED: Borderline image quality was enhanced before grading.
reason_translations.BORDERLINE_IMAGE_UNENHANCED: Borderline image quality was graded without enhancement.

lesion_limitation: Lesion findings are algorithmic evidence candidates and are not clinically confirmed findings.
limitations: This is an AI-assisted screening tool.
It is not a standalone diagnostic system.
Algorithmic lesion evidence is not clinically confirmed.
Confidence values do not represent clinical certainty.
Dataset performance may not generalize to rural clinical deployment.
Human review remains necessary for escalated/uncertain cases.
